class.name: GoapGoal
class.brief_description: A world state a [GoapAgent] wants to bring about.

method.name: _get_desired_state
method.description: Called during planning to replace [member desired_state] with a dictionary computed from the current situation, for instance a goal that targets whichever enemy is closest.

method.name: _get_priority
method.description: Called during planning to replace [member priority] with a value computed from the current situation. This is the usual way to let urgent goals take over.

method.name: _is_valid
method.description: Called during planning to decide whether this goal should be considered at all. A goal that is not valid is skipped without being planned for.

method.name: get_effective_desired_state
method.description: Returns the state the planner will aim for: the result of [method _get_desired_state] when it is overridden, otherwise [member desired_state].

method.name: get_effective_priority
method.description: Returns the priority the planner will rank this goal by: the result of [method _get_priority] when it is overridden, otherwise [member priority].

method.name: is_satisfied
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if every fact of the desired state already holds in [param world_state].

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns the result of [method _is_valid], or [code]true[/code] when it is not overridden.

members.member: The facts that must hold for this goal to be met, in the same vocabulary as [member GoapContext.world_state]. Every extra fact widens the search, so state the outcome and nothing more: prefer [code]{&"has_wood": true}[/code] over spelling out each step that leads to it.
A name used for debugging and for inspecting plans. It has no effect on planning.

How much this goal outranks the others. The planner tries goals from the highest priority down and keeps the first plan it finds, so a high priority goal that cannot be reached costs one failed search and then steps aside.
